'''2014 Worlds Day 3 Matt Sokol DS Hunt Down''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sokol]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 3).

2013 Players Committee sheet. Defensive Shields writes "15 Shields" on line 1 and leaves lines 2–15 blank; those slots are not invented. (V) follows the sheet checkbox. Day 2 Dark was also Hunt Down (a different 60; not copied here).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
